title: A lending library
hints: Store each book with its number of copies, and count how many are out by looking at the loans: then there is only one place that can be wrong.
`DateOnly.DayNumber` turns dates into whole numbers of days, so the days late are `today.DayNumber - due.DayNumber`. `today.AddDays(21)` is the date 21 days later, for the due date.
`public decimal FinesOwed { get; internal set; }` lets the library (in the same project) change fines while other code can only read them.
requirements: `Member` is abstract with `Adult` and `Child` deriving from it; the loan rules come from its properties, not from `if (member is Child)` checks.
The library's collections are private; `LoansOf` hands out a read-only list.
stretch: Add reservations: a member can reserve a book with no copies available, and the next returned copy is held for the first person in the queue.
